title: Draft executive framing: why governance is required beneath orchestration
description: Write the leadership-facing section explaining: (1) why multi-agent deployment creates organisational risk, (2) why orchestration alone cannot provide reliable enforcement, and (3) why a lower-layer governance substrate changes the failure mode from 'surprise' to 'explicit rejection + audit'.
acceptance_criteria: Explains the problem in executive-readable language without implementation detail.
Uses concrete organisational concerns: accountability, auditability, compliance, incident response.
Consistent with site narrative (governance beneath orchestration).
